CADPocket (cadpocket_bg.wasm): 원본 소스 gyecheuk-cloud/cadpocket (cadcraft 결과물, rea로 만든 CADCraft 0.18 모방 뷰어).
빌드: cd cadpocket && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --lib && wasm-bindgen --target web --no-typescript --out-dir ../web/vendor/cadpocket target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/cadpocket.wasm
포함 글꼴: Noto Sans KR (SIL Open Font License 1.1) — 한글·기호만 줄인 것(assets/kr.ttf).
